fonts.notes: This is a system stack, not a bundled font file.

To replace the current font later, the first touch points are miniprogram/app.wxss and any page-level overrides. WeChat mini programs can use local bundled font files or configured font assets, but compatibility and package size must be validated per font. If a custom font is introduced, the editor should modify font tokens/config first, then update WXSS generation rather than patching business markup.
